## 0.2.194

owes: **the home page now speaks for every app, and three new per-user collections carry the hearts.**
`/home` shows one compact tile per enabled app (weather and stocks join feeds and notes), then a
*Hearts* section with the cities, instruments and feeds each account marked with a heart — set on the
phone (`weather.hearts`, `stocks.hearts`, `feed.hearts`: one `{"v":1}` record per item, keyed by that
item's own record id) or here (a *Heart* button on each row of *Manage places* and of the watchlist
editor, and one in a single feed's `⋮` menu). No migration, no configuration key and nothing to
expose: the three names are ordinary per-user collections, so they sync, back up and restore with
everything else, and a rollback leaves the records in the store for the older hub to ignore. Removing
a place or an instrument from the browser now also removes its heart in the same write. The hub
gains one small read-only route, `GET /weather/art/{condition}.svg`, which serves the forecast
pictograms as images for the home cards. The image is built on DataCore 0.5.19 (from 0.5.18), whose
notes owe this hub nothing: `stocks.hearts` is read with the codec the phone shares. (specs/SPECHomeHearts.md)
